fusions.name: Flushed Out
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and strike it for 14 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Twitch Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 3 flicks at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Ears Up
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
